parse.title: Monkey
parse.text:
Overview

Monkey is a Legendary unit. He is only obtainable through the Raid Shop and Rumbling Stars. He can be bought for 50 Path Shards and you need 2 of him to evolve Usurper into Usurper (Founder). He is also the boss of stage 3 of Shiganshinu District as The Beast Titan.

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
